invariants.description: Command Center owns each architectural responsibility exactly once

checks.name: core responsibility registry covers every core contract
duplicate responsibility ownership is rejected
single-owner assertion rejects competing owners

invariants.description: James' Command Center remains the only control plane above specialists

checks.name: specialist model without Command Center control plane is rejected
specialist authority requires the command-center actor
delegation controlled by any other orchestrator is rejected
specialist projections cannot inherit unrelated scope

invariants.description: Delegated authority can only narrow, never amplify

checks.name: equal-or-narrower delegation is accepted
scope amplification is rejected
budget, concurrency, retry and resource amplification are rejected
revoked, stale-policy and expired delegation is rejected
execution scope containment is directional

invariants.description: Canonical registries stay canonical and reject incompatible or duplicated entries

checks.name: duplicate registry keys and version regressions are rejected
incompatible capability versions are rejected and unregistration is residue-free
method contracts require provenance, benchmark and rollback evidence

invariants.description: One architecture: acyclic module graph, no escaping or legacy edges, no foreign control plane

checks.name: no static relative import cycle exists across active source
no active source import escapes clean-room/src
no active source declares a competing control plane
legacy runtime imports are rejected

invariants.description: Representative capabilities and specialists extend and retire without mutating architecture

checks.name: capability can be added through registration and removed cleanly
specialist can be registered, versioned and retired through the registry
protected side effects require fresh exact authorization

invariants.description: Unsupported learning cannot silently become global truth

checks.name: private learning cannot be proposed for global promotion
validated project learning promotes only at its own scope
unvalidated, stale, contradicted and retracted learning cannot stay promoted
global promotion requires every readiness dependency

invariants.description: Self-improvement cannot install itself or expand scope, permission or authority

checks.name: a self-installing proposal is rejected
scope and permission expansion are rejected
snapshots bound to stale policy or invalidated learning are rejected

invariants.description: Evidence, provenance, confidence, risk, cost and privacy controls remain enforced

checks.name: method registration rejects unsupported evidence and expiry ordering
capability maturity cannot be inflated without proof
